scope: product fidelity only (same method as the phase B report): the fin2 code fixes (Nordic A, warm modern, boho), the four ED4 passes (Nordic A, warm modern, mediterranean, japandi) and the new modern-country-A. No lock, grading targets or density

method.nothing_else_moved: independent diff of every pair: |after - before| > 2 levels on any channel, components on a 15 px dilation, boxes against the recorded zones (data/diffs.json)
method.traces: crops at 100% and x3-x4, plus a x4 contrast stretch; a trace counts only if it shows at 100%
method.proportions: against card dimensions and known neighbours on the same plane (bowl vs runner vs cups at the same table row; vase vs vase on the sill; cushion vs cushion)
